N4V3R41N-Suite — Windows instructions
=====================================

N4V3R41N-Suite is a command-line toolkit for Apple-device research:
USB device detection, checkm8 pre-flight checks, an Apple chip
database, and related utilities. It runs in cmd, the same way it
runs in a Linux or Mac terminal: you type a command, it prints
its answer, and you read it.

INSTALL
-------
Easiest way (recommended):
  1. Download N4V3R41N-Setup-v5.2.2.exe from the GitHub release page.
  2. Double-click it, then Next, Next, Finish.
     - No admin rights needed for a normal install.
     - It adds the tool to your user PATH and puts shortcuts in the
       Start Menu (N4V3R41N Doctor, N4V3R41N Help, Instructions).
     - The setup file is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may say
       "Windows protected your PC" on first run. Click "More info",
       then "Run anyway". That is a one-time click.

Zip way:
  1. Download n4v3r41n-v5.2.2-windows.zip and extract the whole
     folder (do not run anything from inside the zip window).
  2. Double-click Install.bat in the extracted folder.

After installing, open a NEW cmd window (old ones do not pick up
the PATH change). To open cmd: press Win+R, type cmd, press Enter.

RUNNING IT IN CMD
-----------------
Type a command and press Enter, exactly like in a terminal:

  n4v3r41n-cli --version        show the version
  n4v3r41n-cli --help           list every command
  n4v3r41n-cli doctor          check your setup (start here)
  n4v3r41n-cli list-devices    list connected Apple USB devices
  n4v3r41n-cli chip-db         list the Apple chip database
  n4v3r41n-cli chip-db A11     look up one chip (or: chip-db 0x8947)
  n4v3r41n-cli checkm8         checkm8 pre-flight for a DFU device

More commands (see --help for the full list):
  sparse-restore, signal-detect, repair-all, identity-fix,
  purple-mode, r1nderpest, spiderpro, mix-bypass, cloudpass,
  bookra1n, auto-spoof, passcode-bypass, brute-force, fmi-off,
  account-logout, passcode-ext, android-host, ai-chain,
  spyware-intel.

Honest limits on Windows:
  - Commands that need the native C backend (purple-mode, r1nderpest
    and some exploit paths) are macOS-only and say so instead of
    pretending. The pre-flight, lookup, and diagnostic commands
    work fully on Windows.
  - auto-spoof binds port 443 and edits the hosts file, so it
    needs an admin cmd window: right-click cmd, "Run as
    administrator", then run the command. Without admin it prints
    exactly what to add to the hosts file by hand.

WHAT ELSE YOU MAY NEED (Windows)
--------------------------------
  - DFU-mode USB access: install the WinUSB driver with Zadig
    (https://zadig.akeo.ie/). Put the device in DFU mode (black
    screen), pick "Apple Mobile Device (DFU Mode)" in Zadig, and
    install the WinUSB driver for it. Then run doctor to confirm.
  - Normal-mode / recovery tools (idevice_id, ideviceinfo,
    irecovery): install a Windows build of libimobiledevice and
    add it to PATH. Doctor warns if they are missing.
  - Android commands (android-host): install Android
    platform-tools so adb is on PATH.
  - Helper scripts: install Python (python.org) if doctor warns
    python is missing. Windows Python registers `python`, which
    doctor accepts.

TROUBLESHOOTING
---------------
  - "Command not recognized" in cmd: you are in an old cmd window.
    Close it, open a new one, and try again.
  - SmartScreen warning on the setup file: "More info" then
    "Run anyway" (see Install above).
  - A command prints NOTHING and returns straight to the prompt:
    something on your PC is stopping the program from starting
    (usually antivirus/Defender flagging an unsigned tool).
    Check: Windows Security > Virus & threat protection >
    Protection history, and look for n4v3r41n-cli entries. If
    one is blocked there, add the install folder
    (%LOCALAPPDATA%\N4V3R41N\bin) as an exclusion, then try
    again. To see the failure code, run:
      n4v3r41n-cli --version
      echo %ERRORLEVEL%
    A non-zero code with no output means it was stopped before
    it could print. As a test, copy n4v3r41n-cli.exe to your
    Desktop and run it from there: if it prints there but not
    from the install folder, something is blocking execution
    from that folder.
  - USB device not found: run doctor first, install the WinUSB
    driver with Zadig for DFU mode (above), and re-plug the
    device.

UNINSTALL
---------
  Settings > Apps > N4V3R41N-Suite > Uninstall, or use the
  Uninstall shortcut in the Start Menu folder. It removes the
  files, the shortcuts, and the PATH entry.
